implementation.note: Verified the rendered line and trail in paired native captures and switched from low to tall impact bands in WebGL2.

architecture.note: The ECS projectile remains authoritative. Presentation interpolates existing scene transforms, and particles read the displayed point.

native_api.note: GameView::projectileImpactPathPoint and straightShotPoint expose current presentation data and interpolation.

skill.note: The look authoring recipe specifies the target setting and side-view check.

mcp.note: rules_get and rules_merge round-tripped the target height without losing the target model.

studio.note: Rules form TypeScript/Vite compiled; native StudioSession wrote the scalar and undo/redo/reopen retained the correct values.

inspector.note: Edit type in Rules uses the existing typed Rules inspector and the field supports write, reset and inheritance. Verified by schema tests and native session history.

persistence.note: A fresh native MCP process reopened the edited target and read the authored height.

graphs.note: Target height is a scalar in the existing unit view. The trail consumes the displayed point regardless of its effect asset; no graph topology or nodes are authored.

performance.note: One million optimized arm64 projections took 0.001518 s. Position interpolation allocates no heap memory and adds no draw passes. Timing excludes draw and particle submission.

platforms.note: Ran a Metal client and Emscripten WebGL2 in Chrome. Additional operating systems and graphics backends were not exercised.

dependencies.note: Extends existing Game View, GameFx and Studio Rules. Both native simulation smoke and frontend production build ran with existing dependencies.

headless.note: The demo ran ten seconds on the native headless host and fired seven times at seed 197.

examples.note: A small interactive range has two targets and a bright trail. The existing headless host ran the scene for 10s and reported 7 attacks.

tests.note: Native interpolation tests, Rules schema, actual MCP and Studio persistence, seven-attack headless range, embedded web content and devlog verification passed. Retested on the integrated Mac tree; see issues-197-202-integrated-mac.json.

handoff.note: Stage records include exact code SHAs, ownership, targeted checks, remaining gates and repro scene.

documentation.note: The models guide documents units, defaults and supported flight paths.

publishing.note: Matched native screenshots, bilingual entry and 19.8 MiB interactive web build verified. MAIN publishes the staged route following the site-demo skill fallback.
